title: Arcade Adventure: Cloud Infrastructure & App Scale
description: Sometimes you just want to skip the endless theory and get straight to building cool stuff. This adventure jumps right into the practical side of Google Cloud, starting with spinning up storage and getting PHP and Go apps live on App Engine. From there, you'll set up custom IAM roles and tweak your network settings so you know how everything fits together. To wrap it all up, you'll tackle the big stuff—deploying a private Kubernetes cluster and running a real distributed load test to see how your setup holds up under heavy traffic. Jump in and enjoy the ride!

title: Arcade Base Camp November 2026
description: Welcome to Base Camp, where you’ll develop key Google Cloud skills (available in Spanish and Portuguese too!) and earn an exclusive credential that will open doors to the cloud for you. No prior experience is required!

title: Arcade Simulator: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description: Welcome to this month's Arcade Simulator, where you'll step into the shoes of a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer responsible for building and scaling rock-solid environments from scratch. You will work extensively with Infrastructure as Code by using Terraform modules, handling state files, and putting your skills to the test in the Terraform challenge lab. From there, you'll set up multiple VPCs, lock down access controls, and finish up with the Secure Software Delivery challenge lab. Clear this challenge to prove you can spin up bulletproof infrastructure and keep it running securely.

title: Arcade Trail: Cloud Security & GKE Cost Control
description: Running workloads in the cloud means keeping two things in check at all times: your security posture and your budget. In this trail, you'll start on the security side—configuring service accounts, exploring Security Command Center, hunting down active threats, and patching vulnerabilities before they become a problem. Once your environment is locked down, you'll switch gears to Google Kubernetes Engine to make sure your clusters run lean. You'll set up multi-tenant namespaces, right-size your virtual machine node pools, and combine autoscaling strategies so you're only paying for the compute you actually need. Knock out both challenge labs on your own to prove you can keep your cloud infrastructure both locked down and cost-efficient.

title: Arcade Voyage: Python Apps & Data Analytics
description: Building a great app is only half the battle—you also need to know how to scale it, optimize its performance, and make sense of the data it generates. In this voyage, you'll build a Python application from the ground up: setting up your dev environment, storing media files in Cloud Storage, adding user authentication, and deploying the whole thing to Kubernetes Engine. Once your app is live, you'll shift gears into operations and analytics—configuring networks via the CLI, tracking down performance bottlenecks with Cloud Profiler, cleaning up raw datasets in Cloud Dataprep, and building custom fields in Looker to turn your data into clear insights. Jump in and get building!

title: Diwali in the Cloud
description: Light up your cloud learning journey with Diwali in the Arcade! Craft radiant Go-powered REST APIs and PDF generators on Cloud Run, and keep your cloud spending glowing and controlled with budget quotas. Keep your digital diyas shining bright by monitoring Apache web servers and Cloud Run functions with the Ops Agent, setting up Windows on Compute Engine, and protecting your pathways with IAM permissions and Privileged Access Manager. Play now to spark your skills and celebrate the festival of lights!
